title: Staged modernization coexistence and rollback model
purpose: Represent a staged traffic shift between a legacy path and a target path, with dual-write lag, reconciliation capacity, divergence accumulation and a rollback trigger, so that coexistence and rollback claims can be bounded.

includes: Traffic share between legacy and target paths

abstraction.boundary: The model starts when traffic is shifted to the target path and ends when a declared rollback drain is complete or the horizon closes.
abstraction.resolution: Fixed-step fluid model over traffic shares and record backlog; individual records are not represented.

state_variables.name: legacy_share
state_variables.description: Share of traffic served by the legacy path.

state_variables.name: target_share
state_variables.description: Share of traffic served by the target path.

parameters.name: arrival_rate
parameters.note: Synthetic request rate during the migration.

equations: share(t) = last declared stage at or before t, or 0 after rollback
target_served(t) = min(arrival_rate * share(t) * dt, target_capacity * dt)
legacy_served(t) = min(arrival_rate * (1 - share(t)) * dt, legacy_capacity * dt)
backlog(t+1) = backlog(t) + target_served(t) * dual_write_lag - min(backlog(t), reconciliation_capacity * dt)
divergence(t+1) = max(0, divergence(t) + (backlog(t) - reconciliation_capacity * dt) * dt * 0.001)

invariants.name: traffic-conservation
invariants.statement: Served plus rejected traffic equals offered traffic at every step.

invariants.name: share-bounds
invariants.statement: Legacy and target shares remain within [0, 1].

invariants.name: non-negative-backlog
invariants.statement: Dual-write backlog and divergence never become negative.

cases.description: A full stage shift with zero lag has no divergence and no rollback delay.
A declared rollback returns traffic to the legacy path and drains the backlog.
Target capacity below offered target traffic produces rejection rather than silent success.

verification.notes: Verification covers the modeled accounting and stage/rollback rules, not a real migration.

calibration.notes: No migration was performed. The model exists to expose what must be measured before a cutover decision.

validity_limits: Valid only for the synthetic stage schedule and capacities recorded in a scenario.
The model does not establish record-level correctness, schema compatibility or rollback safety.
Divergence is a synthetic proxy, not an observed data-quality measure.
assumptions: Traffic can be shifted in declared shares.
Dual-write lag is constant over the stage.
Reconciliation capacity is independent of target load.
unknowns: The real reconciliation throughput under load.
The business cost of divergence and the true rollback duration.
